map.根据涂布面积、干膜厚度、固含量与损耗率，计算理论用量与实际用量（L/kg）: From coating area, dry-film thickness, solid content and loss rate, compute theoretical and actual usage (L/kg).
map.用量 = 面积 × DFT ÷ SV% ÷ (1 − L%)；质量 = 用量 ×: Usage = area × DFT ÷ SV% ÷ (1 − L%); mass = usage × density
map.基于涂布用量模型：涂料用量由涂布面积、干膜厚度 DFT、固含量 SV% 与损耗率: Coating-usage model: usage depends on area, dry-film thickness DFT, solid content SV% and loss rate L%, then × density gives mass; used for painting-material estimation.
map.💡 理论用量 V=A×DFT×0.1/SV (L)；实际用量=V×(1+L/10: 💡 Theoretical usage V=A×DFT×0.1/SV (L); actual = V×(1+L/100); mass = actual × density; coverage rate = A / actual.
map.干膜厚度 DFT 一般 50~150μm，防腐涂层可达 250μm 以上: Dry-film thickness DFT is usually 50–150 µm; anti-corrosion coatings can exceed 250 µm
map.固含量越高、损耗越低，用量越省；损耗率含喷涂飞溅与施工损失，喷涂约 20~40%: Higher solid content and lower loss save material; loss includes overspray and application waste — spraying ≈20–40%
map.涂料密度常见 1.2~1.5 kg/L，富锌涂料可达 2.0 kg/L 以上: Paint density is commonly 1.2–1.5 kg/L; zinc-rich coatings can exceed 2.0 kg/L
map.📚 深度解析：涂料理论/实际用量计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Theoretical / Actual Paint Usage
map.涂料采购：按涂布面积、干膜厚度、固含量与损耗算理论/实际用量: Paint procurement: compute theoretical/actual usage from area, DFT, solid content and loss
map.成本测算：由实际用量×密度得质量并估算采购量: Cost estimate: actual usage × density gives mass for purchase-volume estimate
map.工艺校核：损耗率与固含量直接决定用量: Process check: loss rate and solid content directly determine usage
map.理论用量(L)=面积×干膜厚(μm)×0.1÷固含量(%)；实际用量=理论×(1: Theoretical usage (L) = area × DFT (µm) × 0.1 ÷ solid content (%); actual = theoretical × (1 + loss%); mass = actual × density (kg/L); coverage = area ÷ actual (m²/L). Thicker film or lower solid content → more material.
map.面积 100 m²、干膜 80 μm、固含量 55%、损耗 25%、密度 1.3: Area 100 m², DFT 80 µm, solid 55%, loss 25%, density 1.3 kg/L: theoretical = 100×80×0.1÷55≈14.55 L, actual = 14.55×1.25≈18.18 L, mass = 18.18×1.3≈23.64 kg, coverage ≈5.50 m²/L; purchase rounds 18.18 L up with margin.
map.固含量低为什么用量大？: Why does low solid content mean more material?
map.固含量是成膜物质占比，低则同体积可成膜少，需更多涂料才能达到目标干膜厚度；选购高: Solid content is the film-forming fraction; lower means less film per volume, so more paint is needed for the target DFT; high-solid paints cut usage and VOC.
map.喷涂损耗常 20%~40%、辊涂 5%~15%；本例 25% 偏喷涂工况，实际须: Spray loss is often 20–40%, rolling 5–15%; 25% here leans spray. Use the real application method — omitting loss means under-buying and a color mismatch on re-order.
